name: Ross Tagiobon
heroIntro: Hi! I'm Ross. A Frontend Developer with hands-on experience building fast, accessible and responsive web apps.
heroCode: Proficient in the latest web technologies and
frameworks, continuously expanding my skill set
to stay at the forefront of the industry.
aboutStatement: If it’s slow or confusing, it’s not done yet.
aboutLead: Front-end developer. I turn designs into sites that work on a cheap phone as well as they do on a big monitor.
aboutBody: I’ve been coding for the web for a year now. These days it’s React, Next.js and a lot of small details nobody notices until they’re missing.
Fast pages and accessible markup are where I start, not something I add at the end. I’m happiest on a team that gives honest feedback and doesn’t mind a few questions.
description: Hi! I'm Ross, a Frontend Developer who enjoys building clean, responsive, and user-friendly websites. I focus on creating smooth digital experiences while continuously learning new technologies and improving my skills.
